context: Demo dataset. Reduced energy in the afternoon began in winter 2026. Tests from 2026-06-18 are generally within range except for vitamin D.

hypotheses.title: Vitamin D insufficiency → reduced energy in the dark season
evidence_for: Vitamin D 24 ng/mL against a reference interval of 30–100 (test 2026-06-18)
Symptoms began in winter and became noticeably milder by summer
Morning daylight — about 15 minutes per day
evidence_against: The abnormality is mild and far from severe deficiency
CBC, ferritin, B12, and TSH are within range — common causes of fatigue are not supported
next_steps: Repeat 25(OH)D in three months while taking the supplement
Add 20–30 minutes of morning daylight and assess the trend in the well-being journal

hypotheses.title: Irregular sleep schedule → daytime sleepiness
evidence_for: Bedtime varies by about 1 hour 15 minutes between weekdays and weekends
Nine hours of screen time per day; bedtime follows screen use
evidence_against: Sleep duration is 7.5 hours — within the normal range
Sleep quality is rated 6–8 out of 10 in the journal
next_steps: Record actual bedtimes for two weeks and compare them with energy in the journal
